name: Kamiyama Yuuri
source: Principal of the newly founded Seishuu Academy. Old friends with Maki, often refers to Maki as her older sister in private conversations. Daughter of the head of the Kamiyama family that are of a similar line of educators to Kazuya. A lady of kindness and intellect, she graduated top of her class from Shuukoukan Academy. Her role as Principal of Seishuu is not only a way of proving herself to her family, but also a fulfillment of her love for learning new things and having others experience the same. She would do anything for Seishuu Academy's sake.
translation: 新成立的青修学园校长。她与真纪是老朋友，私下经常称真纪为姐姐。她是神山家家主的女儿，家族与和也家一样世代从事教育。她是一位善良而聪慧的女性，曾以年级第一名从秀光馆学园毕业。担任青修学园校长不仅是为了向家族证明自己，也源于她对学习、以及让他人体验新事物的热爱。为了青修学园，她什么都愿意做。
